name: prompt-ui-testing
description: Prompt-driven black-box testing of web user interfaces with URL-visible evidence.

interface.longDescription: Guide an agent through authorized, black-box web UI testing. Plan and run browser checks against remote or localhost applications, compare expected and observed results, and report PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or INCONCLUSIVE with URL-visible screenshot evidence. A compatible browser capability must be available in the host. Playwright MCP is a separately configured option and is not bundled; without a usable browser, the Skill reports BLOCKED.
capabilities: Test web interfaces using natural-language instructions
Validate forms and file selection workflows
Compare expected and observed UI results
Create screenshots with a redacted current URL
defaultPrompt: Test https://example.com and verify that the page heading is Example Domain.
At http://localhost:4173, test the sample form and select sample-upload.txt.
Plan a test for http://localhost:4173; do not open the page or execute any steps.
